text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's dream as a native of 
Tomakomai: To put Tomakomai on the map and 
revitalize her beloved hometown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She works hard to promote Tomakomai as a 
local idol. In order to raise her profile 
and amplify her reach, winning races was 
also essential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Hokko Tarumae was diligently 
training, her friends Copano Rickey and 
Wonder Acute showed up to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon watched over the scene with 
eyes full of anticipation—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer vowed to support both her 
racing and local idol activities to make 
Hokko Tarumae's dream come true. And so, 
the days of their shared challenge began!
